_comment: Vulcanised rubber, as a shoe sole (Phase08 8.3, RD-P08-6: rubber is synthetic/polymer). OPAQUE, matte, near-black: carbon-black-filled rubber, the common sole. The one dark wardrobe article (RD-P08-5's exception: a Creator rarely lightens a sole). No texture: a sole's tread is the mesh's, not the substance's (D1).
name: Rubber_Natural_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.why: Carbon-black-filled vulcanised rubber: albedo ~0.035 (near-black, neutral), matte (roughness 0.75: a moulded, unpolished surface), IOR 1.52 (natural rubber ~1.52). No measured rubber in Physically Based.
